April 2026 winner Dr. C. Vijayabaskar (AIADMK) resigned; seat vacant since 16 June 2026 per TN Explorer. He was one of six AIADMK MLAs who resigned in 2026. The Madras High Court barred the ECI from notifying a by-election from 10 July 2026 (order extended 31 Jul, 24 Aug, 8 Sep; orders reserved 1 Oct 2026) because an election petition against the April result is pending, so the seat remained VACANT as of Oct 2026 with no by-election date. Sources: https://tnexplorer.com/elections/tn2026/seats/ and https://tnexplorer.com/elections/tn2026/answers/how-by-election-works/

meta.notes: SEAT VACANT as of October 2026: Dr. C. Vijayabaskar (AIADMK) resigned on 16 June 2026 and joined Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam on 2 July 2026; the by-election is stayed by the Madras High Court and had not been held. This entry records the April 2026 winner.
